title: feat: use a `Map` in `getWatched`

body:
When `cwd` makes a watched directory's key exactly `__proto__`, `getWatched()` invokes the inherited setter instead of creating an own property. The directory disappears from `Object.keys()` and JSON output, and the returned object's prototype becomes its child array.

Define each directory as an enumerable, writable, configurable own data property, preserving the existing `Object.prototype` return type and sorted child lists. Add real filesystem regressions for empty/nonempty `__proto__` directories with cwd and absolute paths, ordinary siblings, serialization, sorting and behavior after close. These tests run in the existing native, recursive-preferred and polling suites.

Fixes #1493.

Validation on macOS / Node 22.22.3:
- `npm ci`
- `npm run build`
- `npm test` — 461 tests passed
- `JSBT_FILTER=getWatched npm test` — 18 tests passed; new regression failed before the fix
- `npm pack --dry-run`
- Prettier check for both changed files
- CI's backend parity benchmark smoke configuration

The two-file diff also passed an independent review.
title: fix: include __proto__ directories in getWatched
